rules.name: Trolleater
rules.description: Regeneration (5+), Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 3).

rules.name: Godspeaker
rules.description:
Attached, Fearless. 
The bearer’s unit gains Unstable (the model may join units without Unstable during Deployment despite having Unstable).

rules.name: Scraplord
rules.description:
Commanding Presence (12", Scrapling). 
Units with Scrapling property lose Unruly as long as the bearer is on the Battlefield. 
As long as the bearer is joined to a unit of Scraplings, its model counts as being of the same Height as its unit for the purpose of allocating Ranged Attacks.

rules.name: Hoardmaster
rules.description:
+1 Arm, Weapon Master, and may not take any Weapon Enchantment. 
In addition, the bearer gains the following weapons: Great Weapon, Halberd, Paired Weapons, Iron Fist.

rules.name: Headhunter
rules.description: At the end of any Round of Combat in which the model part has caused a HP loss on enemy models and did not break from combat, roll a D6: on 3+, the model Recovers 1 HP.

rules.name: Firebrand
rules.description:
Shamans with one or more spells from Pyromancy only
Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks), Flaming Attacks, Resistance, and automatically fails all Regeneration Saves. 
The model can cast Dragon’s Roar (Pyromancy) as a Bound Spell (5+).

rules.name: Gut Roarer
rules.description: Channel (1), Horror.

rules.name: Spinesplitter
rules.description: The bearer gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att, +1 Str, +1 AP).

rules.name: Rottenjaw
rules.description:
Poison Attacks, Immune (Poison Attacks). 
 Friendly Kin-Eater units may reroll failed Ambush rolls while the bearer is on the Battlefield.

rules.name: Banner of the Gyengget
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains First Strike (re-roll to-hit and to-wound rolls of ‘1’).

rules.name: Pennant of the Great Grass Sky
rules.description: The bearer’s unit’s Charge Range rolls gain Maximised, and its Flee Distance rolls gain Minimised.

rules.name: Skull of Qenghet
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Terror.

rules.name: Khagadai's Legacy
rules.description: Multiple Wounds (D3).

rules.name: Viper's Curse
rules.description:
Poison Attacks (Melee & Shooting). 
 Shots set to 4, Str 4, AP 2 and always hits on 4+. It cannot benefit from Area Attack, Direct Hit.

rules.name: Heart-Ripper
rules.description: +1 AP, Lethal Strike and always hits at least on 3+.

rules.name: Ritual Bloodletter
rules.description:
+1 Att. 
 While the wielder’s unit is Engaged in Combat, the it can cast Hand of Glory (Occultism) as a Bound Spell (4+).

rules.name: Aurochs Resilience
rules.description:
Height 1-4 only
+1 Res, and Mountain Hide. 
 The model automatically fails all Special Saves.

rules.name: Wrestler's Belt
rules.description: +1 Arm, +1 Str and Devastating Charge(+1 Arm).

rules.name: Mammoth-Hide Cloak
rules.description: +1 Arm. Attacks against the wearer can never have Str above 5.

rules.name: Lygur's Tongue
rules.description: Afflict(-2 Off).

rules.name: Yeti Furs
rules.description: Touch of Frost, Strider.

rules.name: Rampager's Chain
rules.description: The bearer gains Stomp Attack(D3+1), and all models in the bearer's unit must reroll failed to-wound rolls with Stomp Attack.

sharedRules.name: Animal Master
sharedRules.description: The model gains Commanding Presence (12", Sabretooth Tigers).

sharedRules.name: Leader of the Pack
sharedRules.description:
The Mammoth Hunter’s base size is changed to 50×50 mm.
 The model replaces Exclusive (Yetis) with Exclusive (Sabretooth Tigers). 
 While joined to a unit of Sabretooth Tigers, the unit gains Vanguard, loses Unruly, and the Mammoth Hunter counts as being of the same Height as the unit for the purposes of allocating Ranged Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Wildheart
sharedRules.description:
The minimum amount of Army Points that must be spent on Core units is reduced to Min. 20%, and Mammoth Hunters become Common. 
 The Army List may not include any of the following units: Great Khans, Khans, Bruisers, Bombardiers, Mercenary Veterans, Mercenary Gunners with Brace of Ogre Pistols, or Thunder Cannons.

sharedRules.name: Touch of Frost
sharedRules.description: An enemy unit suffers -1 Agi (to a minimum of 1) for each unit containing Touch of Frost it is in contact with.

sharedRules.name: It’s a Trap!
sharedRules.description:
When an enemy unit performs any of the following actions, it suffers 2D6 hits with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 1, and Unmodifiable: 
 • The enemy unit successfully Charges a unit containing It’s a Trap! in contact with a Terrain Feature. 
 • The enemy unit comes into contact (while it was not in contact earlier) with a Terrain Feature that is in contact with a unit containing It’s a Trap!. 
 Resolve the hits at the end of the action that triggered them. No unit can be affected by It’s a Trap! more than once in each Player Turn (including from different units containing It’s a Trap!).

sharedRules.name: Freezing Aura
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 12" of one or more Frost Mammoths suffer -3 Agi (to a minimum of 1).

sharedRules.name: Dengrai’s Ice Storm
sharedRules.description: The model can cast Veil of Mist (Druidism) as a Bound Spell (4+).

sharedRules.description:
During step 1.2 of Pregame Planning (Build an Army), choose one of the following Model Rules, and write your choice on the Army List:
